title: A Wedding in Garrison
text: LIVES there the man, moderately enriched with the blessings of social and domestic ties, who does not number among his relatives some valuable and valued living record of the olden time; some white-haired specimen of age's loveliness, whose reminiscences he would willingly enshrine in somewhat less perishable than tradition, and whose virtues, nay, whose very fast fading peculiarities, he would fain transmit to the admiration of posterity?
